sections.why: Wood and leather are the material base for tools, armor, and containers - every other chain consumes what this card makes (pouches hold rations, buckets carry water, straps bind packs).
sections.how: Per task-831. Hide→leather is a 2-deep chain (cure then tan); wood outputs feed fire recipes as salvage (split log → firewood) so crit-fails stay in-world instead of vanishing.
sections.verify:
1. Gate over this card's files.
    - expected: clean; hide chain unbroken; salvage outputs are real fuel ids.
    - observed: 2026-10-16 - `recipe_check.py --check`: all 93 clean
      (13 new + 80 prior). Salvage outputs are `split_blank`,
      `snapped_stick`, `firewood` - all real fuel ids. 37 item files
      authored (incl. `worn_boots` as the repair subject, which had
      no library entry).
2. Cure → tan → straps → pouch end to end.
    - expected: chain completes; fail degrades one step without breaking the next.
    - observed: 2026-10-16 - chain test green through straps;
      pouch proves separately (one hide feeds one downstream item
      per pass). Repair modeled honestly: the engine cannot eat a
      kept input on crit only, so patch-boots keeps the boots and
      says so - boots-destroyed needs per-input outcome flags.

acceptance.text: Salvage outputs reference real fuel/material ids.
New outputs exist as library files.
